# Better pricing for fast-growing teams


November 11, 2026 • Magic Patterns Team


Today, we're updating our Starter and Business plans to remove per-seat pricing and introduce shared workspace credits. **Same subscription pricing and credits, now with unlimited team members.**


These changes are designed to make Magic Patterns more affordable and flexible for growing product teams. **Under our new workspace subscriptions, nearly all existing customers would see their costs decrease or remain the same if they switched.**


We designed these changes based on feedback from thousands of customers to ensure our pricing is fair and transparent, and helps you build faster without arbitrary constraints.


---


# What's changing


# Unlimited team members on paid plans


All paid plans now include unlimited team members. Invite designers, engineers, and product managers to collaborate on your canvas at no additional cost.


# Shared workspace credits


Previously, credits were allocated to individual users. Now, everyone in your workspace draws from the same shared credit pool, so credits can be used wherever they're needed most.


# More flexible subscription options


We're introducing more credit packages to better match your team's usage. Choose a subscription that works for your team, with optional on-demand credits when you need extra capacity.

# Availability and migration


Our new pricing is available to all new customers starting today.


Existing customers can continue on their current plans or choose to migrate to our new workspace-based pricing. To switch, simply contact us atsupport@magicpatterns.com , and we'll help you make the transition.


We'll also proactively reach out to existing customers who could see significant savings under the new plans.


---


# Built for teams


We believe you should pay for the work being done, not the number of people doing it.


With shared workspace credits, it's easier than ever to bring your whole team into Magic Patterns and build together.


[Explore our new pricing](https://www.magicpatterns.com/pricing)
